instruction: Replace the email body text with 'Please find attached the AWS invoice for December 2023. Total amount due: $10.02.'

command: import os; profile_dir = os.path.expanduser('~/.thunderbird'); profiles = [d for d in os.listdir(profile_dir) if d.endswith('.default')]; draft_file = os.path.join(profile_dir, profiles[0], 'ImapMail/outlook.office365.com/Drafts') if profiles else None; content = open(draft_file, 'r', errors='ignore').read() if draft_file and os.path.exists(draft_file) else ''; original_body = open('/home/user/.aws-bill-mail-body.html', 'r', errors='ignore').read() if os.path.exists('/home/user/.aws-bill-mail-body.html') else ''; has_new_text1 = 'Please find attached the AWS invoice for December 2023' in content; has_new_text2 = 'Total amount due: $10.02' in content; original_removed = original_body not in content if original_body else True; print('Body replaced!' if has_new_text1 and has_new_text2 and original_removed else 'Body not replaced')

metadata.explanation: Task requires replacing the email body with specific text. Evaluator checks if both required text snippets are present in the draft and that the original body content was removed (ensuring true replacement, not appending). Similar difficulty to original (body modification vs attachment action). Verified that the expected text includes invoice amount from the PDF ($10.02).
